Watch a video about Bandwidth Classes, including the Large Files bandwidth class (shows legacy UI).

The Large Files page allows you to configure the minimum file size for bandwidth classes. The service enforces bandwidth throttling when users attempt to download or upload files that are equal to or greater than the specified file size. To learn more, see About Bandwidth Classes.

To specify the minimum file size:

From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Resources > Bandwidth Classes.
Go to the Large Files tab.

Click Edit to set the minimum file size.

See image

The Edit drawer appears.

In the Edit drawer, for the Large Files section, select a minimum file size from the drop-down menu.

See image.

Click Save and activate the changes.
